name: 태양 상수 / Solar constant
partial: 1 for the correct expression with an arithmetic slip; a value outside the range used consistently later is not penalised again.

name: 원판의 복사 수지 / Disk radiative budget
requirement: Disk at z = 0 absorbs pi R_E^2 S_0 on the Sun-facing face and emits from both faces 2 pi R_E^2 sigma T_0^4, so T_0 = (S_0/(2 sigma))^{1/4}. Zero albedo for the disk.
partial: Emitting area pi R_E^2 (one face, T_0 = (S_0/sigma)^{1/4} = 393 K): 1. Emitting area 4 pi R_E^2 or albedo 0.30 applied to the disk: 0.

name: T_0 수치 / Value of T_0
partial: 1 for a value off only through a carried S_0 error. Bare number with no budget: 0 here and in 16.2.

name: 비교 구의 복사 수지 / Comparison-sphere budget
requirement: (1 - alpha) pi R_E^2 S_0 = 4 pi R_E^2 sigma T_g0^4, so T_g0 = [(1 - alpha) S_0/(4 sigma)]^{1/4}.
partial: 1 if alpha is applied to emission instead of absorption, or the absorbing area is 2 pi R_E^2.

name: T_g0 수치 / Value of T_g0
partial: All or nothing; a consistent carried S_0 error is accepted.

name: 기하 인자와 알베도 인자 / Geometric and albedo factors
requirement: With T_s0 = (S_0/(4 sigma))^{1/4} = 278 K: G_geom = T_0/T_s0 = 2^{1/4} = 1.19 (1.18921); G_alb = T_s0/T_g0 = (1 - alpha)^{-1/4} = 1.09 (1.09327). Accept +-1 in the third significant figure.
partial: 1 each. Ratios inverted: 0 for that factor.

name: 두 인자의 곱과 온도 비 / Product and temperature ratio
partial: 1 for the numerical ratio T_0/T_g0 without identifying it with the product (or vice versa).

name: 기하 설정 / Geometric set-up
requirement: Unit vectors about N: S = (sin eps_p, 0, cos eps_p), Z = (sin eps_p cos phi, sin eps_p sin phi, cos eps_p) with Z = S at phi = 0; or the spherical triangle N-S-Z with sides eps_p, eps_p and included angle phi at N; or an equivalent rotation argument.
partial: 2 for a correct triangle/vector picture with one misidentified side or angle. No geometric set-up (formula quoted): 0 here.

name: cos z 식 / Expression for cos z
requirement: cos z = S . Z = cos^2(eps_p) + sin^2(eps_p) cos(phi) (spherical cosine rule with a = b = eps_p, C = phi).
partial: 2 for a sign/phase error inconsistent with Z = S at t = 0 (e.g. cos^2 eps - sin^2 eps cos phi): 1. Error carried from 17.1 with consistent algebra: 2.

name: 천정거리 z / Zenith angle z
requirement: z(eps_p, phi) = arccos[ cos^2(eps_p) + sin^2(eps_p) cos(phi) ] on the principal branch 0 <= z <= pi.
partial: Only cos z given (z itself not stated): 0 for this criterion.

name: z의 범위 / Range of z
requirement: z_min = 0 at phi = 0; z_max = 2 eps_p = 47.0 deg (0.820 rad) at phi = pi; z < 90 deg so the face is always lit.
partial: 1 each for the minimum and the maximum.

name: 투영 면적 수지 / Projected-area balance
requirement: pi R_E^2 S_0 cos z = 2 pi R_E^2 sigma T^4 (projected absorbing area, two emitting faces).
partial: 1 if the projection factor is cos^2 z or sin z; 0 if the emitting area is not 2 pi R_E^2 (unless carried from 16.2, then 1).

name: 세차 온도 / Precessing temperature
requirement: T = T_0 [cos^2(eps_p) + sin^2(eps_p) cos(phi)]^{1/4}.
partial: T = T_0 (cos z)^{1/4} without expressing it in eps_p and phi: 1.

name: 냉각 조건 / Cooling condition
requirement: Set T(phi_*) = T_0 - Delta T: (1 - Delta T/T_0)^4 = cos^2(eps_p) + sin^2(eps_p) cos(phi_*).
partial: 2 for a linearised condition (e.g. 4 Delta T/T_0 = sin^2 eps (1 - cos phi)) stated as an approximation; 0 for a heat-capacity or cooling-rate model.

name: 대수적 역산 / Algebraic inversion
requirement: Delta t = (P/(2 pi)) arccos{ [ (1 - Delta T/T_0)^4 - cos^2(eps_p) ] / sin^2(eps_p) }, symbolic in T_0, Delta T, eps_p, P.
partial: 3 for an algebra slip in the inversion; 2 for a wrong time scaling (e.g. P/pi). A justified small-angle inversion Delta t = (P/(2pi)) sqrt(8 Delta T/T_0)/sin(eps_p): 3.

name: 최초 냉각 구간의 가지 / First-cooling branch
requirement: The first future cooling crossing lies in 0 < phi_* < pi, so the principal arccos is taken; 2 pi - phi_* is the warming crossing.
partial: 1 if the principal value is used without justification. Choosing 2 pi - phi_* (Delta t ~ 24.2 kyr): 0.

name: 위상의 수치 / Phase value
requirement: phi_* = 0.392 rad (0.39179 rad = 22.4 deg), with trigonometric functions evaluated consistently in radians or degrees.
partial: 2 if a degree/radian mix-up is the only error; accept 0.391-0.393 rad.

name: Δt 수치 / Value of Delta t
requirement: Delta t = 1.61e3 yr (1608.76 yr; accept 1.60e3-1.62e3 yr, which also covers T_0 rounded to 330 or 331 K). A stated small-angle approximation giving 1.60e3 yr (1602 yr) is accepted.
partial: 2 for the correct method with a unit slip (e.g. result in units of P not converted, or seconds); 0 for an unrelated cooling model.

name: 최저 조건 / Minimum condition
requirement: T is minimal where cos z is minimal: cos(phi) = -1, phi = pi (z = 2 eps_p).
partial: 1 if phi = pi is stated without any argument.

name: T_min 식 / Expression for T_min
requirement: T_min = T_0 (cos^2 eps_p - sin^2 eps_p)^{1/4} = T_0 (cos 2 eps_p)^{1/4}.
partial: Either form earns 2. 1 for a power error (e.g. exponent 1/2) or a sign error inside the bracket.

name: T_min 수치 / Value of T_min
requirement: T_min = 300 K (300.347 K; accept 300-301 K, the upper end from T_0 rounded to 331 K).
partial: All or nothing; a carried T_0 error used consistently is accepted.

name: 최대 온도 강하 / Largest fall
partial: 30 K or 31 K obtained only by subtracting temperatures already rounded to 3 s.f.: 1.

name: 최저 온도의 최초 시각 / First time of the minimum
원판·대기층 수지식 / Budgets of disk and layers
requirement: With eps = 1 - t_lw, F = sigma T^4, A_+- = sigma T_A+-^4: front layer 2 eps A_+ = eps F + (1 - t_sw) S_0; rear layer 2 eps A_- = eps F; disk 2F = t_sw S_0 + eps (A_+ + A_-). A summed atmospheric budget is equivalent if solar absorption is counted once.
partial: 1 per correct budget. Layer emissivity set to 1, or sunlight sent to both layers: that budget 0.

name: T_E^flat 식 / Expression for T_E^flat
requirement: Elimination gives (1 + t_lw) F = (1 + t_sw) S_0/2, so T_E^flat = [ (1 + t_sw) S_0 / (2 sigma (1 + t_lw)) ]^{1/4}.
partial: 1 for an elimination slip after correct budgets; consistent carry-forward from one wrong budget: 1.

name: T_E^flat 수치 / Value of T_E^flat
partial: Value consistent with a carried formula error: 1.

name: 구형 지표·대기 수지식 / Sphere surface and atmosphere budgets
requirement: Post-albedo input J = (1 - alpha) S_0/4; atmosphere 2 eps A = eps F_s + (1 - t_sw) J; surface F_s = t_sw J + eps A.
partial: 1 for J, 1 per correct budget. Albedo applied twice (again at the surface) or unspecified surface reflection recycled: 0 for the affected budget.

name: T_E^sph 식 / Expression for T_E^sph
requirement: T_E^sph = [ (1 - alpha)(1 + t_sw) S_0 / (4 sigma (1 + t_lw)) ]^{1/4}.
partial: 1 for an elimination slip; consistent carry-forward: 1.

name: T_E^sph 수치 / Value of T_E^sph
partial: Value consistent with a carried formula error: 1.

name: 공통 인자와 비 / Common factor and ratio
partial: 1 each.

name: 로그 민감도 / Logarithmic sensitivities
partial: 1 each; a missing minus sign on the t_lw derivative loses that point.

name: 온도 변화 / Temperature changes
requirement: First order: Delta T = T_E^flat (d ln T/d t) (0.010): +0.488 K for t_sw only, -0.772 K for t_lw only (accept +-0.002 K, or the exact finite changes +0.487 K and -0.768 K).
partial: 1 for the linearisation method, 1 for each signed value. Wrong sign: 0 for that value. The two increments applied simultaneously as one answer: -1.

name: 기록의 반복 간격 / Record repeat interval
requirement: P_rec ~ 100 kyr read from successive peaks (e.g. about 123, 237, 330, 410 kyr BP) or troughs of the bottom curve; accept justified readings 80-120 kyr.
partial: 1 for a value in range with no stated reading method. A value outside 80-120 kyr (e.g. 41 or 23 kyr from the upper panels): 0.

name: 기록의 온도 폭 / Record temperature range
requirement: A_rec ~ 10 K peak-to-trough (the curve spans about +3.6 to -8.2 deg C); accept justified readings 8-13 K.
partial: 1 for an amplitude (half range) of 4-6.5 K given instead of peak-to-trough.

name: 주기 비 / Period ratio
requirement: P_rec/(23 kyr) ~ 4.35, consistent with the student's own P_rec (e.g. 3.5-5.2 for 80-120 kyr).
partial: All or nothing; must be consistent with 21a.1.

name: 원판 모형의 기본 주기 / Disk fundamental period
requirement: T depends on t only through cos(2 pi t/P), so P_disk = P = 25.8 kyr.

name: 원판 모형의 온도 폭 / Disk temperature range
requirement: A_disk = T_0 - T_min = 30.2 K (from (d); accept 30.0-30.4 K or a value carried from 19.4).
partial: All or nothing.

name: 두 통과 시각의 합 / Sum of the two crossing times
requirement: Equal-temperature phases are phi_c and 2pi - phi_c (T(P - t) = T(t)), so t_c + t_w = P = 25800 yr for every T_min < T_* < T_0.
partial: 1 for the symmetry stated without the sum, or the sum stated without the symmetry.

name: 기록과의 비 / Ratios to the record
requirement: P_disk/P_rec ~ 0.258 and A_disk/A_rec ~ 3.02 for P_rec = 100 kyr, A_rec = 10 K; any values consistent with the student's own 21a readings are accepted.
partial: 1 each.

name: 구형의 흡수 플럭스 / Sphere absorbed flux
requirement: F_sph = (1 - alpha) pi R_E^2 S_0/(4 pi R_E^2) = (1 - alpha) S_0/4 = 237 W m^-2 (236.788; accept 236-238), independent of phi, so m_sph = 0.
partial: 1 for F_sph, 1 for m_sph = 0.

name: 원판의 흡수 플럭스 / Disk absorbed flux
requirement: F_disk(phi) = pi R_E^2 S_0 cos z/(2 pi R_E^2) = (S_0/2)[cos^2(eps_p) + sin^2(eps_p) cos(phi)].
partial: 1 if normalised by the absorbing area (S_0 cos z) instead of the emitting area.

name: 원판의 상대 변동 폭 / Disk relative variation
requirement: m_disk = (F_max - F_min)/F_max = 1 - cos(2 eps_p) = 2 sin^2(eps_p) = 0.318 (0.318002).
partial: All or nothing.

name: 위상 평균과 비 / Phase average and ratio
partial: 1 each. Averaging temperature instead of flux: 0.
